notes.title: Recall: Empty Wishes Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that our partners have released a new 2D horror game titled [b][i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/5f1e83ce3acd9fd28dc5cc5cf6a61afe852b4b20.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683270/Recall_Empty_Wishes/

Set in Taiwan during the 2010s, [i][b]Recall: Empty Wishes[/b][/i] is a story-driven interactive adventure that follows Yonny, a young woman searching for answers behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper into the past, she encounters an eerie world where forgotten wishes take shape, leading her to relive fragmented memories from multiple perspectives of key characters connected to Tommy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/2dda5fe1dfad56f69ac215971681409fab9df2fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/fe0af87cc82e7735a60b4490664051aa61ef71d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/4fe05ff22d24395a756a521d3c706492a7d68285.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
When Yonny’s beloved brother, Tommy, vanishes without a trace, her determination to uncover the truth leads her to a surreal realm connected through an old toy phone receiver they used to play with as kids. This mysterious device allows Yonny and her friend, Phoebe, to delve into the memory echoes of key individuals tied to Tommy’s fate, revealing their deepest desires and secrets.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Through interactive 2D side-scrolling gameplay, players will relive pivotal moments in the lives of key characters, unravel a tangled web of mystery and emotion, and uncover choices that shape the story’s haunting conclusion. With a unique blend of fantasy, mystery, and horror, Recall: Empty Wishes invites players into an emotional detailed narrative that explores the fragile boundaries of memory, truth, and longing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/fa6e9f5b4660c00a3aa1541c4777cac423f9b5b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/3987c615f1cf0b6f88130920ab86db605dc9699e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/24971231b0ee53813a7146f2057f27ca53e3b2bc.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
- Unravel a gripping psychological mystery set in Taiwan during the 2010s with a connective cast of characters and multiple endings.
- Experience the story through multiple perspectives, immersing yourself in different characters' memories.
- Explore a hauntingly beautiful world crafted with pixel-art backgrounds and hand-drawn portraits.
Solve environmental puzzles and interact with forgotten wishes to reveal hidden truths.

Inspired by story-driven games such as [i]To the Moon[/i], [i]The Coma[/i], and [i]Detention[/i], [b][i]Recall: Empty Wishes[/i][/b] is Puff Hook Studio’s first game project, and has received the following awards:
[list]
[*] Vision Get Wild PC Game 2021 - Bronze Award
[*] Bahamut ACG Award 2021 - TAICCA Special Award
[/list]
Recall: Empty Wishes will have a 10% launch discount for a limited time! Please check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775614/1058f2421238e81a96e00df92cb718a5f484d20c.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683270/Recall_Empty_Wishes/

notes.title: Version 1.1.8 (Live)
Loretta is available NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=78Kf2hOkOmI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Loretta is out! Hooray![/h1]

Loretta is a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes, leading her through a self-crafted nightmare. This story revolves around a woman handling betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, and reclaiming her agency during the socially tumultuous 1940s. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592540/Loretta/

I sincerely thank everyone who took part in the creation of this game, my friends, colleagues and each of YOU for continuing to follow my work!

I sincerely hope you enjoy Loretta as much as I enjoyed working on it. Please feel free to leave feedback, write comments, share it with friends and help others learn about our humble game, and, of course... play it! :)

And thanks to all!

Sincerely,

Yakov
